title: Fullstack Developer, later Team Lead
bullets: Maintained an OpenCart store; built a Yii manager portal and AngularJS 1.x product configurator with visual editing, compatibility rules and calculated pricing.
Created the configurator’s database tables, dependencies and relationships, plus internal configuration forms for administrators and managers.
Led three direct reports, handling hiring, task allocation, code review and technical decisions.
Responded to a DDoS incident by placing the site behind a gateway and removing origin-IP exposure.
